architecture: Two dense/ReLU/dropout blocks; four separate one-unit linear heads; sigmoid inference. BCEWithLogitsLoss is stable sigmoid+BCE.
failure: STOP; no more configs, search, reweighting, thresholds or seed changes
final_if_pass: Only if BOTH focal gates and CAD/LAD gates in BOTH strata pass: select ONE joint-eligible config using previous LCX full-development4inner folds; mean LCX/RCA BA then PR-AUC then ROC-AUC then rank. Median inner best epoch; fit all242. If no jointly eligible config, no freeze. Never old holdout/deploy.

gate.policy: Same v2 operational gate; ALL25 focal rules eligible, mean fold floors, 4/5 complete repeat-pooled floors; no extreme repeat; PPV/PR/AP above prevalence+.05; all-task safeguards also required.

holdout_use: FORBIDDEN; sealed v1 bytes only, never deserialize outcomes/results

outer.policy: Reuse each previous target's exact outer/4-inner folds. Each model learns all four tasks. Focal vessel determines inner model selection only. 50 outer fits total, not 50 independent samples. CAD/LAD assessed separately in both strata, never pool duplicate patients across strata.

preprocessing: Exact v1 linear SchemaGuard / training-fit StandardScaler and auto dense OneHotEncoder(ignore unknown). 55 raw fields; encoded width fold dependent. No targets, imputation, global vocabulary, feature selection or calibration.
references: Reuse sealed, same-fold v2 development OOF RF@0.5 / RF nested threshold / v2 selection_procedure. Refit CAD/LAD exact v1 balanced logistic C0.1, seed42 on each outer TRAIN only; @0.5. Do not load all-development v1 fitted models.
report: Outer selection-procedure evaluation, never independent test or confidence interval. Repeat SD descriptive only; conditional comparisons disclose ineligible subsets.
selection: Among inner focal-eligible configs maximize pooled focal BA, trapezoidal PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, then smallest predefined rank; scores rounded12. If none eligible, ranking-only highest inner focal ROC selects diagnostic CAD/LAD/@0.5 predictions, never a fallback screening threshold. Nonfocal vessel has its own inner threshold.

threshold_rule.select: highest inner-OOF probability among unique p plus0/1 using >=

training.determinism: Python/NumPy/torch fixed seeds; deterministic algorithms; CPU1thread
training.early_stopping: Fixed first 5-fold stratified/group-safe holdback from each inner TRAIN; scaler/encoder fit only on remaining 80%. Scoring inner validation and outer rows never passed to stopping.
training.loss: sum(weight * per-task mean BCE)/sum(weights), no class weighting
training.refit: Fresh network+preprocessing on all inner TRAIN for private-holdback best epoch. Outer TRAIN fresh refit for nearest-half-up median of the four inner best epochs. No outer stopping or threshold feedback.
training.seed: SHA256(context) first8 hex mod(2^31-1); stopping split context+'/stop'; same fit seed across 16 configs, refit +1; no seed search
